streams.reasoning: Chemistry Plan specifies single stream for all reagents to ensure catalyst activation. Concentration 0.1 M from Engineering Calculations Step 1. Flow rate 0.5 mL/min derived from residence time target.

mixing_order_reasoning: Chemistry Plan states single stream simplifies mixing; all components soluble in DMF. Pre-mixing ensures catalyst activation before heated zone.
pre_reactor_steps: Deoxygenate DMF solution via sparging with inert gas (N2 or Ar) prior to pumping, as Pd(0) is oxygen sensitive (Chemistry Plan).
post_reactor_steps: Collect product stream. No chemical quench required (Chemistry Plan).
chemistry_notes: Suzuki-Miyaura coupling is thermally driven. Batch used microwave at 50 C for 10 min. Flow design targets 3x intensification (tau ~ 3.3 min) but constrained by inventory and mixing limitations. Engineering calculations indicate mass-transfer limitation (Da >> 1) and axial dispersion (Pe < 100) with 1.0 mm ID tubing. Single stream used per Chemistry Plan. No light source used. BPR not required as T (50 C) << BP DMF (153 C).

reasoning_per_field.residence_time_min: Batch time is 10 min. Engineering calc suggests 0.5 min for 3x intensification, but warns of mass transfer limits. Analogy 1 (similar T, solvent) used 12 min. To ensure conversion given mixing limitations and conservative screen objective, we match batch time (10 min) using the 5 mL reactor at 0.5 mL/min. This is a conservative first screen.
reasoning_per_field.temperature_C: Fixed at 50 C per Hard Constraints and Batch Protocol.
reasoning_per_field.BPR_bar: Engineering Calc Step 8: BPR not required. T=50 C is well below DMF boiling point (153 C).
reasoning_per_field.tubing_material: PFA selected from Inventory. Compatible with 50 C and DMF. Not photochemical, so transparency not critical, but PFA is standard.
reasoning_per_field.reactor_volume_mL: Selected 5.0 mL from Inventory to achieve 10 min residence time at 0.5 mL/min. 10 mL reactor would require 1.0 mL/min or longer time.
reasoning_per_field.flow_rate_mL_min: 0.5 mL/min calculated to achieve 10 min residence time in 5 mL reactor (V/t). Within Syringe Pump A limits (0.01-5.0 mL/min).
reasoning_per_field.tubing_ID_mm: 1.0 mm from Inventory. Engineering calc warns of axial dispersion (Pe=6) at this ID, but it is the only option available.
